narration: Norway were this close to knocking England out. Then one man ruined the fairytale — Jude Bellingham. Norway hit first, and England looked shaky. But Bellingham dragged them level, and in extra time he strikes again. Two-one. A brace. Game over. Haaland's Norway are out. England march into the semifinals, still chasing their first World Cup since nineteen sixty-six. Next up: Argentina. This one is getting serious.
title: Bellingham BREAKS Norwegian Hearts 💔 England Into the Semis!
description:
Jude Bellingham scored twice — including a dramatic extra-time winner — as England beat Norway 2-1 to reach the World Cup semifinals. Haaland's Norway are eliminated. England now chase their first title since 1966, with Argentina next.
